Title: ESG Fundamentals
Description: The complete on-ramp to ESG: what it is, how it evolved, India's regulatory landscape, BRSR reporting, and the career paths it opens — in bite-sized video lessons.

Title: Fundamentals of ESG & BRSR
Description: The vocabulary, the actors, the regulations, and a working knowledge of the BRSR framework Indian listed entities file under.
Outcome: Master GRI, BRSR, SASB and CDP, the frameworks employers hire for.

Title: GHG Accounting Mastery in 20 Hours
Description: Scope 1, 2 and 3 from first principles, ISO 14064-aligned, with the spreadsheets and audit trail your assurance partner will accept.
Outcome: Calculate Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions and lead your org's carbon disclosure.

Title: ESG Readiness
Description: Build an ESG program from scratch: governance, materiality, KPIs, and the rollout plan that actually survives Q1.
Outcome: Build a board-ready ESG strategy from scratch.

Title: Materiality Assessment Mastery
Description: Learn to run a materiality assessment end to end: stakeholder engagement, issue prioritization, building a materiality matrix and double materiality. Leave able to identify what truly matters and turn it into strategy, risk and reporting.
Outcome: How materiality fits within ESG framework

Title: Life Cycle Assessment Mastery
Description: Learn to measure, analyze, and optimize the environmental impact of products, processes, and supply chains.
Outcome: Mastery of LCA principles, methodology, and reporting

Title: CBAM Mastery Course
Description: Master EU-CBAM compliance for aluminium and iron & steel: scope, embedded-emission calculation, reporting and verification. Leave able to prepare a defensible CBAM report and protect EU market access, with worked sector case studies.
Outcome: What CBAM is, why it exists, and how it fits within carbon pricing and the prevention of carbon leakage

Title: Circularity Mastery Course
Description: Master the circular economy across nine modules: core models, circular design, materials, waste recovery, business models, policy and AI. Leave able to apply tools like LCA and MCI to real products and propose business and policy ideas.
Outcome: Apply circular-economy models and frameworks to real products and systems

Title: Live Training: Master Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
Description: Live, instructor-led LCA: work a real product system through ISO 14040/14044 (goal & scope, inventory, impact assessment, interpretation) with direct feedback on your model.
Outcome: Conduct a full life cycle assessment, ISO 14040/44 compliant.

Title: Become an ESG Reporting Pro
Description: A four-week intensive that takes you from data to a defensible ESG report: disclosure structure, the evidence trail, and the review cycle assurance partners expect.
Outcome: File a GRI/BRSR report that survives external assurance.
Instructor(s): Karuna Kalra, Maitri Desai, Shriya Singh

Title: Become a Certified GHG LEAD VERIFIER
Description: Become a job-ready carbon Lead Verifier in 5 days, certified by Bureau Veritas. Master ISO 14064 accounting and auditing, then India's CCTS compliance, with mock audits and exam prep. Verify carbon claims under global and Indian regimes.
Outcome: ISO 14064 gives you the globally accepted methodology for quantifying and verifying greenhouse gas claims; the CCTS module grounds that methodology in the rules, formulas, and timelines of India's compliance market.

Title: Carbon Markets Mastery - Live Bootcamp
Description: Learn to design and validate carbon credit projects, run MRV, navigate registries and Article 6, and trade and procure credits. Live expert sessions and real-world case studies leave you ready to operate in carbon markets, not just describe them.
Outcome: Navigate carbon registries (Verra, Gold Standard, GCC, Puro Earth) to trace a credit from issuance to retirement

Title: Sustainability Leadership Bundle
Description: Built for mid-career professionals moving into ESG leadership. Six execution-focused courses across reporting, materiality, GHG, circularity, CBAM and LCA, plus career services. Leave ready to lead ESG transformation and get hired.
Outcome: By the end of this bundle, you'll be able to execute ESG leadership and strategy transformation initiatives
Bundle Courses: esg-readiness, fundamentals-esg-brsr, ghg-accounting-mastery, esg-materiality, lca, circularity, cbam

Title: ESG Mastery Essentials
Description: Built for professionals ready to execute ESG strategy and reporting inside any company. Three execution-focused courses across ESG & BRSR fundamentals, materiality assessment and GHG accounting. Leave able to deliver ESG work with confidence.
Outcome: By the end of this bundle, you'll be able to execute ESG reporting and strategy for any company

Title: Emission Mastery Essentials
Description: Master a company's full emissions picture, operational and embedded. Two execution-focused courses in GHG accounting and lifecycle assessment, with hands-on training in LongSight, OpenLCA, GaBi and SimaPro. Become execution-ready on emissions.
Outcome: By the end of this bundle, you'll have mastery over everything related to a company's emissions, operational and embedded emissions
